title: The four entry-point commands run through a linked .planning and not on import
statement: With `.planning` a junction to the tool checkout on Windows and a directory symlink on POSIX, `bin/setup.mjs`, `bin/start-kiln.mjs`, `bin/init-project.mjs` and `bin/generate-stage-skills.mjs`, each invoked through the link, execute their command. Each run is asserted to have executed by an observable effect of that command, not by its exit status, so none of these linked invocations exits 0 without running. Importing each of the four as a module runs no command. Verified on Windows and the supported POSIX CI platform.
notes: PASS 2026-09-24 on EVD-0148: all four commands run through a real junction (Windows) and directory symlink (POSIX), each proved by its effect, and importing any of them runs nothing. CI run 36077139114 passed all four cells.
